description: Subdomain takeover check: lists up to 10 subdomains seen in certificate transparency logs for a domain (Cert Spotter), fetches each over HTTPS, and flags pages that show a known 'unclaimed service' message (GitHub Pages, S3, Heroku, Fastly). Looks at the page text only, not DNS records, so it can miss dangling records that show no such message. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

domain.description: Domain such as example.org (a URL is reduced to its host)
